name: Anekano ~Onee-chan to Ecchi de Amai Himitsu no Kankei~
original_name: アネカノ～お姉ちゃんとえっちであまーいヒミツの関係～
source:
The debut work of [url=/p1678]Chococo[/url]. 
The main protagonist Ringo is youngest child and only son in his family. Surrounded by his three older sisters, Tsubaki, Sakura, and Kaede, and his loving parents, he has a gentle personality and leads a normal life, helping with the housework. 
Then one day, Ringo witnesses Sakura masturbating. He is very surprised to see his sister, whom he admires so much, doing something like that...... but he cannot forget the sight he has seen and eventually ends to relieve himself on said memory.
After that, he encounters Tsubaki naked in the bathroom, and later Kaede teases him in her underwear.
Each of these incidents was so tempting and stimulating for Ringo, that he ends being no longer able to see his sisters as sisters. 
After becoming aware of his sisters as a girls, Ringo's life drastically changes. It's a thrill to secretly do naughty things with his favorite sisters behind his family's back. 

[Shortened synopsis from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=688519]Getchu[/url]]
